organic_results.title: SSL Certificate Verification - Requests Documentation
organic_results.snippet: Requests can verify SSL certificates for HTTPS requests, just like a web browser. By default, SSL verification is enabled, and Requests will throw a SSLError if the certificate cannot be verified. You can pass verify=False to disable verification on Session.get() or requests.get().

organic_results.title: Developer Interface - Requests Documentation
organic_results.snippet: Session.get(url, **kwargs): Sends a GET request. Returns Response object. verify parameter accepts boolean or string path to CA bundle. Supported in current stable version 2.32+.
